context: Tests whether the agent applies the versioning rule: accessibility and bug fixes go into the existing version, a new version is only for breaking changes.

checklist.name: Fixes in place
checklist.description: The fix is made inside `textinput/v1` and no `textinput/v2` folder is created

checklist.name: States the rule
checklist.description: `DECISION.md` says a bug or accessibility fix goes into the existing version and a bump is only for breaking DOM, JS contract or authored properties

checklist.name: Checks the markup
checklist.description: The fix keeps the existing DOM and JS contract, for example an `aria-live` or `role` attribute on the error element, and does not rename classes or data attributes

checklist.name: Honest verification
checklist.description: `DECISION.md` lists the checks run (static validator, accessibility checklist) and names any that could not run, such as Cypress
